changeReason: V1.2 safely rejected contextual routing, while its development split showed a promising global wide-retrieval profile. V1.3 separates global policy evolution from contextual routing and adds predeclared 640/768/896/1024-token Pareto arms. All baselines are rerun.
policyStages: Select a globally safe Pareto profile on development data
Train a selective contextual router with the selected global profile as fallback
Promote global and contextual stages independently
